name: vitta
description: Scripts de conveniencia do monorepo Vitta (orquestra API .NET, Angular e IA).

scripts.setup: npm --prefix src/Vitta.Client install && dotnet tool restore && dotnet restore Vitta.slnx
scripts.dev: npm run db && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:api" "npm:web"
scripts.dev:all: npm run db && concurrently -k -n api,web,mobile,ai -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm:api" "npm:web" "npm:mobile" "npm:ai"
scripts.test: dotnet test Vitta.slnx && npm --prefix src/Vitta.Client test && cd src/Vitta.AI && .venv/bin/pytest -q
